input.note: Leonardo openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare, 2048x768 (the model accepts wide sizes; log line 79), picked from 6 frames (3 LOW trials at 8 credits, 2 MEDIUM trials at 20 credits, 1 MEDIUM at 20). The prompt uses the city-night rules (props.json: a wide night city from a high studio, no foreground, no window frame or mullions, no text, signs or logos, a skyline band that continues at both edges) and restates the style block palette and finish. The picked frame (2026-10-24, fidelity sprint) is a dense blue night city of towers with many small warm and cool window lights, no frame and no readable text; it replaces the dim, sparse 2026-10-21 frame that read too dark (r5, element 14).

mesh_acceptance.note: trivial for a matte panel (no generated mesh): re-imported from final.glb, 1 mesh object, 74 vertices, 72 tris, 72 of 72 faces point at the arc centre, 1 UV set, one emissive-only slot (city_backdrop_emissive); no floaters or holes by construction (one strip of quads).

scale.note: fallback scale (no window size in wolf-plan.md or plan.md): a 180 degree arc (measured -90 to 90), radius 10 m, 6 m tall, pivot at the arc centre on the floor. Wolf confirms against the real window layout.

finishing.note: strip 1792 x 768 PNG, edge-matched (edge step 0.03386 against 0.03194 typical, 0.11627 before the fade); dimmed x0.58 (strip max luminance 0.58); in the evidence render the backdrop's brightest pixel is 0.5798 display luminance and the table's edge strip clips at 1, so the backdrop does not outshine the strip; every file under 10 MB (largest 2247118 bytes); evidence rendered with Cycles on the CPU. Not claimed: any UE import.

poly_budget.note: trivial: 72 tris for a curved panel against 200 (plan.md P4 gives no backdrop row; the figure is a sanity cap)

materials: city_backdrop_emissive (emissive-only: base colour black, the matte strip as the emission texture at strength 1.0; unlit in effect, no light response)

bounds_cm.note: x, y up, z depth (glTF); a 180 degree arc of radius 10 m: 2000 wide, 600 high, 1000 deep (the half circle); height runs from -1.0 m to +5.0 m about the pivot

pivot: the arc centre on the floor plane (the centre of the half circle, height 0). The arc lies on +Y in Blender (+Z in the GLB), behind a viewer at the near edge of the table. Put the pivot at the light table pivot; the panel bottom is 1.0 m below it so the horizon band sits near 1.4 m.
scale_reasoning: No plan gives a window size (wolf-plan.md and plan.md only say "a matte panorama behind the windows"), so the panel is the fallback: a 180 degree arc. Radius 10 m (far enough that head motion has little parallax against a table of 1.2 x 0.8 m), 6 m tall. The panel shows rows 0 to 0.8 of the picture (UV v, bottom up; the empty sky above is cut), so the visible strip is 1792 x 614 px on an arc of 31.4 x 6 m. Wolf may rescale to the real windows.
textures: textures/city_backdrop_basecolor.png: 1792 x 768 PNG, the wide matte strip. The picked frame's last 256 columns are cross-faded into its first 256, so the right edge continues into the left (tileable horizontally; edge step 0.03386 against 0.03194 for a typical neighbouring column pair, 0.11627 before the fade). Dimmed by a factor 0.58 in encoded sRGB (max luminance 0.58, 99th percentile 0.5138, mean 0.1373). Wire it as the emissive colour; no normal or ORM map (a matte painting has no surface).

generator.prompt: a wide night city panorama seen from a high studio through tall windows, for the matte behind the studio windows. A broad city of mid-rise and tall towers along a wide river of light, the nearest towers taller and brighter, the far city a soft glittering haze. Backdrop rules: one wide panoramic strip of a night city seen from a high-rise studio, towers at middle and far distance across the whole width, a skyline band that continues seamlessly at the left and right edges, a dim deep blue night sky with soft haze glowing over the city, many small bright window lights, no foreground, no window frame, no mullions, no glass reflections, no room interior, no people, no moon, no stars, no text, no signs, no logos, no lettering, no billboards. Materials: towers as near-black blue silhouettes filled with many small lit windows in warm amber and cool white, a few red rooftop lights, streets far below as fine strands of warm light, haze in cyan-white and blueprint blue, photographic night look with soft light glow. Palette with roles: ground: blueprint blue #0B2A6B to #123A8C; linework and volumes: cyan-white #BFE8FF; attention (pins, scan, agent head): amber #FFB547; decision accents: warm paper #F3E9D2; studio: near-black blue #0A0F18. Finish: soft bloom on edges, light haze, warm practical lights against a cool table, slight film grain. Never: galaxy or star imagery, neon cyberpunk clutter, fisheye, readable fake text, purple gradients.
